verdict.rationale: Netlify is a web hosting and deployment platform, so a global CDN with edge caching is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence shows static site hosting, deploys, HTTPS and DDoS protection, but no item mentions a CDN, edge caching, cache headers or global asset distribution. The only edge reference is a third-party Turso integration for edge functions, which says nothing about serving static assets from an edge cache.
